issues.affected_requirement: Comprehensibility: labels and layout should make the comparison understandable at the intended size.
issues.improvement_concern: Reserve sufficient header space and ensure labels are layered above, or placed fully outside, the heatmap cells. Verify the final raster at its intended display size so every condition name remains complete and legible.
issues.observation: In Panel A, the rotated condition headers overlap the heatmap and are partly obscured by the first data row; in the rendered image several labels appear only as fragments, making the columns unnecessarily hard to identify. The SVG confirms that the headers are positioned immediately above the grid, while the generation code draws them before drawing the cells, allowing the cells to cover the overlapping portions.

root_cause.explanation: The supplied code places rotated headers close to the grid and renders them before the heatmap rectangles; the observed clipping is consistent with the later cell drawing overwriting parts of the labels.

limitations: This feedback is limited to the supplied public evidence and rendered image; it does not infer any private scoring rationale.

No scientific or numeric defect was identified: the public numeric check reports all 98 ledger entries matching the supplied three-decimal values, and the figure visibly retains negative values and distinguishes the oracle.
